title: Add procedures to import configuration packages and manage table operations in Fabric API
summary: The Fabric API now supports resetting and removing tables, and importing configuration packages through new API procedures.
key_points: Added API procedures to reset a table through the Fabric API
Added API procedures to remove a table from the Fabric API
Added API support for importing configuration packages
Implemented configuration package management logic in the Fabric Config Package Management codeunit
Added test coverage for the new package import functionality
quote: Currently there are no API calls for the following actions: Reset a table, remove a table, import a configuration package
